g.text: Public files in, a contract-checked star schema out. Rules C1-C7 are those of the gold data contract.
beds by site and discipline, CSV 2010-2023
Databricks: Unity Catalog, Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline (Asset Bundle, serverless)
Solid: data flow. Dashed: the parity test checks that both implementations give the same gold tables, value by value.
